Penal Code, 1860: Alteration of conviction from u/s. 302/34 to s. 304 Part I/34 – There was a verbal duel followed by scuffle between the parties – Prosecution alleged that accused persons assaulted the other party, which also led to a homicidal death – all the four accused u/s 302/34 IPC – High Court held that the assault was made on spur of the moment without premeditation and that both sides had suffered injuries and altered conviction u/s.304 Part I – Two accused were acquitted as their presence was found doubtful – On
